question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

We had been collected and studied over 14,000 dung beetles from 98 different species.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 'We had been collected and studied...' is passive voice in sense. But in this sentence the passive voice doesn't make any sense here. As the passive structure of past perfect tense given here is **Subject + had + been + past participle form of main verb (V3) + object**
 
• The correct format should be '** We had collected and studied over 14,000 dung beetles from 98 different species.' **We must **omit 'been' **from this sentence. The correct format for this will be **Subject + had + V3 + object **
 
• **​**Some more examples are as follow 
 
 
• They **had advertised **for the company over the past two years.
 
• My cousin** had left** our home before I** returned** to Goa.
 
 

​Hence, the correct sentence is '**We had collected and studied over 14,000 dung beetles from 98 different species'.**
